thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Structured-output + function_call path saturation detected on prod. Error rate spiking for requests that include function_call/structured_output. 5xx up, KV cache pressure. Investigating.

maria: Seeing a big surge from a few tenants hitting fncall-heavy prompts. Totals: fncall token rate x3 baseline, queue length up 200ms p50 -> 700ms. Customers: tenant-42, tenant-88, tenant-ev, tenant-acme are top contributors.

aj: Copy. Confirming scale map: allocator queues filling on GPU pool-a, fallback to CPU shards happening which amplifies latency. Root cause looks like sudden increase in structured JSON emissions + tool orchestration loops.

srinivas: Can we rate-limit at the route level for function_call-enabled requests? Prefer tenant-scoped soft-disable first so we don't disrupt everyone.

maria: Agreed. Plan proposal: 1) soft-disable function_call per-tenant for top offenders 2) enforce max_structured_tokens=1024 globally 3) route new toolcall-heavy traffic to model-compat (no-fncall) fallback.

carla: We need a quick customer-impact note. Which customers will see degraded features vs full outage?

maria: tenant-42 and tenant-ev will see tool-call features suppressed (they'll still get text responses). tenant-88 is on dedicated capacity so we can throttle instead of disable. acme is small bursty, just apply global token cap.

aj: I'll prep a short middleware to strip function_call hints when tenant flag is off. Pushing as hotfix to runtime: remove function_call trigger in request pipeline, return header X-Redwood-Toolcall-Disabled: true.

maria: Commands to apply: use admin API (only ops role)

maria: ```bash
# soft-disable function calls for tenant-42
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://admin.redwood.example/api/tenants/tenant-42/config \
  -d '{"features":{"function_calls":"soft-disabled"}}'
```

srinivas: I'll apply a per-route soft rate limit as fallback: 10 rps -> 2 rps for requests with header Accept: application/structured+json for tenant-ev.

aj: Deploying a hotfix in canary now that strips function_call entrypoints and sets a metric flag (fncall_strip=1). Deploy-bot: start canary?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for runtime/hotfix/fncall-strip v2026.3. Will monitor 5m and 15m windows.

maria: While aj's canary runs, I'll update rate limits via the traffic-controller: set token cap and structured_size cap globally.

maria: ```yaml
# traffic-controller patch
global_caps:
  max_structured_tokens: 1024
  request_rate_limit: 12000 # global base
rules:
  - match: headers["Accept"] contains "structured"
    action: apply_rate_limit
    rate: 2000
```

carla: Noting customer comms: we'll send a short bulletin to tenant-42 and tenant-ev that function-calls may be temporarily disabled and recommend retries/backoff. Ops to craft message.

srinivas: Canary looks good so far: no increased 5xx in canary hosts; fncall_strip metric shows expected drop. Rolling to pool-a partial.

aj: Rolling to 30% of pool-a -> matches attenuation plan. Also adding middleware to reject requests with structured_output_size > 8k chars with 429 to avoid downstream OOM.

maria: Executed tenant patches: tenant-42=soft-disabled, tenant-ev=soft-disabled, tenant-acme=max_structured_tokens enforced. tenant-88=throttled route, not disabled.

opsbot: Ticket created: INC-2026-1789 "Fncall overload mitigation - tenant-scoped soft-disable" assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://tickets.redwood.example/INC-2026-1789

carla: Please include exact wording for customer note. Keep it short, non-technical. I'll post once you confirm.

maria: Draft: "We're seeing elevated errors when customers use function/tool calling. To protect overall service, we've temporarily disabled tool calling for a small set of high-volume customers. Your text responses will continue. We're working on a fix and will update within 2 hours."

carla: Approved. I'll send to tenant-42 and tenant-ev now.

srinivas: Follow-up ops: collect p95 latency, 5xx counts, GPU queue lengths, and fncall_strip=true rate. Add to INC ticket.

aj: Added quick monitoring dashboard panel and alert suppressed for 10m so we don't get flooded during mitigation actions.

maria: Handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. @aj you'll be primary for runtime rollouts, @srinivas you'll own SRE/traffic controller. If situation changes (5xx > 1% cluster-wide or latency p95 > 2s), escalate to pager.

aj: Ack. Will keep canary metrics and escalate if regressions.

srinivas: I'll keep an eye on GPU queue and reclaim capacity if needed. Have playbook link pinned: https://wiki.redwood.example/playbooks/fncall-overload

maria: Summary of actions taken: [1] Tenant-scoped soft-disable applied to tenant-42, tenant-ev. [2] Route throttle applied to tenant-88. [3] Global max_structured_tokens=1024 enforced. [4] Runtime middleware hotfix (fncall_strip) deployed to canary -> partial rollout. [5] Customer comms sent. [6] INC ticket created and assigned.

carla: Thanks — will coordinate postmortem owner once incident stabilizes.

deploy-bot: Rollout v2026.3 -> pool-a at 40% complete. No regressions detected in the last 5m.

maria: Handing off to day shift. Ping channel with any new regressions.

aj: One more note: we'll add a short-term eval to detect prompt patterns that are triggering infinite-tool loops and block those inputs at the edge. Filing a follow-up RFC.

maria: Good call. I'm out. :wave:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1789 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Last updated by maria at 1894071599.
